api_response.title: Implement bounded PoN runtime, Cell releases and native certificate checks
api_response.body:
The strict public-readiness reader no longer rejects the existing selected-schema backend solely because its frozen source contract predates GSC2 selection. It now recognizes the exact current StateBackend implementation and opener binding while continuing to accept only the original 4775-byte legacy evidence. This changes two Python files and preserves both original failed predecessor jobs losslessly. Rust state/store, schemas, signed domains, profiles, caps and all production authority remain unchanged.

The complete original external-evidence-contract lane passes on the exact canonical candidate: 11 unittest suites / 254 executions, including all original32 readiness methods plus2 new negative-control methods. CI-contract85 and source-integrity33 also pass. Controls reject wrong/bypassed selection, rebound or mutated settings and alternate namespaces. This is bounded lexical contract validation, not a general semantic verifier or growth-backend qualification. Full strict release workspace/all-target/all-feature Clippy (-D warnings), fmt, locked25-member Cargo graph and full raw tracked-byte before/after guards pass separately. Historical validators retain their original measured-source scopes. The actual head/merge tuples and current remote CI are recorded below.

The earlier bounded obligation inventory remains read-only: it validates rows, canonical metadata, totals and prior funding without reserving funds, metering work or dispatching effects. Parent-step operations bind actual parent/adapter identities and refuse failed training residue. Existing runtime controls, budgets, sticky failure and production refusal remain. These components still require their complete native acceptance exits.

Exact final source pair (2026-10-22):
- Chain #323 head `8d56f2f173d3e870846cf1129d48647f2b84540a`, tree `f53921c1eeaad533734aa93b3ac4a8750965b662`, direct parent43f64f; main base `9fedf7ecbbe07177069c030592b4e03dcffebb81`, actual GitHub prospective merge `fed157967df3841d6e821099346fa8d93a454aaa`, verified ordered[base,head]/same tree.
- Hepta #2559 head `c38e7727220f32c7410f59083c5ea7878bbae078`, tree `6ab79ebde4932a05b10bf803ad2904ecc8cb3006`, direct parent5003a9; existing stacked base `75531105b27329abaeb955e77c2c04a6d14f3bcb` (`ci/hepta-chain321-flush-private-current-main-20261016`), actual GitHub merge `a7f7d3be5aa35fc589666dc6e05ef447f4ead405`, verified ordered[base,head]/same tree.
- Both publications are normal CAS fast-forwards. Full raw head/actual-merge guards pass: Chain4243entries/684486163B; Hepta9798entries/113270267B. Existing paired source-head and coordinated actual-imported-base-merge planners pass; they explicitly require actual native source-head success and are not execution receipts. Both canonical worktrees were restored clean.

Exact current-source CI (snapshot completed2026-10-22 12:22:49 UTC; nonterminal work is not accepted):
- Chain [required39776374899](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/actions/runs/39776374899), [priority39776374912](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/actions/runs/39776374912), [analysis39776366238](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/actions/runs/39776366238), [export39776374942](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/actions/runs/39776374942). Current CodeQL119818040273 is NEUTRAL with "2 configurations not found" at the observation; this is not security PASS and earlier43 FAIL13high stays separately unresolved.
- Hepta's first exact-c38 [full Rust39777244649](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39777244649) uses `ci/hepta-full-ci-20261022-c38e7727220f`, created only after current-head run enumeration showed no existing full run. [Pair39777201529](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39777201529), [blocking39777201542](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39777201542), [Windows39777201473](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39777201473), [YAML39777201478](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/hepta-private-ci/actions/runs/39777201478) remain pending/queued/in progress. No current complete native acceptance.
This work did not rerun or manually cancel any old or queued workflow. Successful component tests, metadata plans, NEUTRAL/skipped/cancelled outcomes and predecessor SHAs cannot substitute for the whole final-source exits.

Original failure provenance: [required39739585771](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/actions/runs/39739585771), jobs119704319042 and119704319200 at predecessor871269, both fail the old evidence contract. Their checker/test/store blobs remain identical through43f64f, establishing a deterministic latent source-contract mismatch at43, not a claim that its queued required run executed or failed. [Committed raw failures/readback](https://github.com/TrillionniumFoundation/Trillionnium-Chain/tree/8d56f2f173d3e870846cf1129d48647f2b84540a/evidence/pon-six-gate-closure-20261022/current-871269-required-external-contract) preserve original failures and scoped local validation. No prior failure is rewritten as success.

Predecessor evidence remains explicitly source-scoped:
-43f64f CodeQL check119783358048 failed13high. Analysis39765017614 success and export39765025432 success do not clear it. All original13 annotations, the141833-byte ZIP and35members/manifests verify; API Rust subset234 is not full uploaded SARIF. Historical main18/branch224 are separate. Authenticated alert mapping and independent disposition remain open; no alert dismissal or suppression patch.
-43f64f campaign39765025310/job119778224075: original68,717,452-byte ZIP/all911members and readback verify,189 submissions/27 confirmed rounds, but only6/18 hostile windows overlap observed depletion. Later freshness projections cannot revise earlier exhaustion/admission. No minimum valid work or sustained public-WAN proof.
-The exact43 real CPU pilot passed2loaders then failed phase3 supervision with rss-exit-cleanup-observation-unavailable and same-call ENOENT2. Child exit0/10steps/verified933544-byte candidate remain unqualified; no install, later9phases or three rounds. A trustworthy monotonic resource owner is still missing; polling/preopening/wait4 does not repair the original proof gap, and cgroup charged memory is not automatically an equivalent RSS budget.
-42424a signed growth reached65537accounts/height257 with cooperative recovery/cold opens/freshGSC2reader. Original resource intervention keeps qualification UNKNOWN; initial reader failure stays. Bounded execution/witnesses/migration and physical failure qualification remain open.
-5003 Hepta fullRust39769810885 ARM archive119794223357 failed during compilation on runner shutdown143, below its declared60minute cap; no compiler/test failure or unique shutdown cause established. Windows39769766661 jobs119794889947/119794890213 reproduce outside-delete permission and unqualified restricted-launch refusal. These are predecessor-source failures, not outcomes of the new Hepta repair.

PN0–PN5 remain open: complete exact final CI/security and functional Windows isolation; separate W1 correctness/minimum attack-cost/public attacked-service proofs; signed bounded state growth/recovery/migration; three real evaluate–publish–fetch–install–next-use rounds allowing legal no-update; native locks for five budgets with monotonic resource ownership and durable external-operation reconciliation; three independent administrators/hosting/failure domains with preregistered72-hour WAN fault/repair.

For PN4, nonce-bound task replay is already prevented even after zero-row cleanup; semantic external-operation dedup is a different unresolved requirement. Simply making Unknown escrow permanent can fill the shared256 positive-row pending-task/quota/release capacity. Refund, authenticated negative settlement, Unknown resolution and reorg funding replacement must be specified and tested before implementing authority.

Draft / SHADOW_ONLY / DENY_ALL / HOLD_NO_GO remain. No main, force, merge, Ready, required-check/test/resource weakening or production activation.
